text:
Nina: Quick note before the SI kickoff: CloudBridge wants a one-line handoff flow so their pre-sales doesn't conflict with our AEs. Can we standardize?
Carlos: Yep. Proposal: origin-based TTL + required fields. TTL: marketplace=48h, web=72h, ae=168h. If AE lead, AE must schedule scoping within 72h or scheduling rights become 'partner-ok'.
Eve: Required fields: crm_id, domain, lead_source, lead_score, product_vertical, partner_coc_email. If missing, partner-bot rejects and DMs sender.
Sam: Add embargo enum [joint_announce, legal_review, hw_bundle] with defaults (14, 7, 21 days). partner-bot should compute no_contact_until and block demo bookings.
partner-bot: Can validate payloads and set embargo windows. Emits events: lead.claimed, lead.scheduled, lead.flipped. Rejection message includes missing fields and row index.
Nina: For multi-territory accounts add territory_priority and fallback_owner_list. Higher priority wins; if tie, most_recent_owner; if still tie, round-robin.
Carlos: Also include demo_reserved boolean and preferred_demo_lead (sales|partner). For hw_bundle leads require legal opt-in before marketing demos.
Eve: Let's keep the handoff CSV header tiny: crm_id,account_name,domain,lead_source,owner,ttl_hours,lead_score,product_vertical,demo_reserved,embargo_reason,partner_coc_email,territory_priority,notes
Sam: I'll prototype a webhook that validates CSV rows and posts errors to the channel. ETA: 2 business days.
Nina: Great. I'll add a 2-line SLX email template to the playbook and tag CloudBridge. Ready for tomorrow's kickoff. :thumbsup:
